title.zh: 细胞城市：细胞器的类比

clips.send: In the middle stands City Hall: the nucleus. It stores the DNA, the master blueprints, and sends out copies of the instructions.
clips.text: In the middle stands City Hall: the nucleus. It stores the DNA, the master blueprints, and sends out copies of the instructions.

clips.send: Animal-cell cityTwo buildings disappeared: the stone wall (no cell wall) and the solar food farm (no chloroplasts). Animals eat their food instead of making it. The water tower shrank too: animal cells have only small vacuoles.
clips.text: 🐾 Animal-cell cityTwo buildings disappeared: the stone wall (no cell wall) and the solar food farm (no chloroplasts). Animals eat their food instead of making it. The water tower shrank too: animal cells have only small vacuoles.

clips.send: Central vacuoleOne huge vacuole full of cell sap: stores water and keeps the plant cell firm.
clips.text: Central vacuoleOne huge vacuole full of cell sap: stores water and keeps the plant cell firm.

clips.send: MitochondrionPower plant: releases energy from food (sugar + oxygen) in cellular respiration.
clips.text: MitochondrionPower plant: releases energy from food (sugar + oxygen) in cellular respiration.

clips.send: Start with any organelle. Hover or long-press a token to see its job.
clips.text: 👆 Start with any organelle. Hover or long-press a token to see its job.

clips.send: Next stop, the post office: the Golgi body. It finishes the proteins, packs them into bubble-shaped vesicles and ships them where they are needed, even outside the cell.
clips.text: Next stop, the post office: the Golgi body. It finishes the proteins, packs them into bubble-shaped vesicles and ships them where they are needed, even outside the cell.

clips.send: Every organelle has a job, just like every building in a city. A strong analogy matches the job, not the looks. Now build your own Cell City!
clips.text: Every organelle has a job, just like every building in a city. A strong analogy matches the job, not the looks. Now build your own Cell City!

clips.send: Golgi bodyModifies, sorts and packages proteins into vesicles and ships them where they are needed.
clips.text: Golgi bodyModifies, sorts and packages proteins into vesicles and ships them where they are needed.

clips.send: Pick a color, then tap a part. Tiny ribosome dots count too!
clips.text: Pick a color, then tap a part. Tiny ribosome dots count too!

clips.send: Every city needs a border. The cell membrane is the checkpoint: it lets some things in and keeps others out. Plant cells also have a stiff cell wall outside it, like a stone city wall.
clips.text: Every city needs a border. The cell membrane is the checkpoint: it lets some things in and keeps others out. Plant cells also have a stiff cell wall outside it, like a stone city wall.

clips.send: CytoplasmJelly-like fluid that fills the cell and holds the organelles; many reactions happen in it.
clips.text: CytoplasmJelly-like fluid that fills the cell and holds the organelles; many reactions happen in it.

clips.send: Plant cities also have solar food farms: chloroplasts use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make sugar, and they give off the oxygen we breathe.
clips.text: Plant cities also have solar food farms: chloroplasts use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make sugar, and they give off the oxygen we breathe.

clips.send: ChloroplastUses sunlight to make food (sugar) by photosynthesis.
clips.text: ChloroplastUses sunlight to make food (sugar) by photosynthesis.

clips.send: Animal cells are cities without the stone wall or the solar farms: no cell wall, no chloroplasts, and only small vacuoles. Animals eat their food instead of making it.
clips.text: Animal cells are cities without the stone wall or the solar farms: no cell wall, no chloroplasts, and only small vacuoles. Animals eat their food instead of making it.

clips.send: Power plants: the mitochondria. They use oxygen to release the energy stored in sugar, making ATP, the energy every other building runs on.
clips.text: Power plants: the mitochondria. They use oxygen to release the energy stored in sugar, making ATP, the energy every other building runs on.

clips.send: Cell wallStiff outer layer of plant cells: supports and protects the cell and gives it shape.
clips.text: Cell wallStiff outer layer of plant cells: supports and protects the cell and gives it shape.

clips.send: Why do plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large central vacuole, but animal cells don’t?
clips.text: Why do plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large central vacuole, but animal cells don’t?

clips.send: It is a thick fluid that holds the organelles, and many chemical reactions happen in it. Jelly sets solid; cytoplasm keeps flowing. Watch the cytoplasmic-streaming video in the photo gallery!
clips.text: It is a thick fluid that holds the organelles, and many chemical reactions happen in it. Jelly sets solid; cytoplasm keeps flowing. Watch the cytoplasmic-streaming video in the photo gallery!

clips.send: NucleusControl center: holds the DNA (instructions) and directs the cell’s activities.
clips.text: NucleusControl center: holds the DNA (instructions) and directs the cell’s activities.

clips.send: ERNetwork of tubes that moves proteins and other materials around the cell (rough ER has ribosomes; smooth ER makes fats).
clips.text: ERNetwork of tubes that moves proteins and other materials around the cell (rough ER has ribosomes; smooth ER makes fats).

clips.send: Explain why the mitochondria are like a power plant.
clips.text: Explain why the mitochondria are like a power plant.

clips.send: Plant vs animal check: tap the 3 parts of this plant cell that an animal cell does NOT have.
clips.text: 🔍 Plant vs animal check: tap the 3 parts of this plant cell that an animal cell does NOT have.

clips.send: Zoom into a leaf. Every tiny green box is a cell, and each one works like a busy city with thousands of jobs to do.
clips.text: Zoom into a leaf. Every tiny green box is a cell, and each one works like a busy city with thousands of jobs to do.

clips.send: Ribosomes are the workshops: they read the instructions and build proteins. Many sit along the rough ER, a highway network that carries the new proteins through the cell.
clips.text: Ribosomes are the workshops: they read the instructions and build proteins. Many sit along the rough ER, a highway network that carries the new proteins through the cell.

clips.send: Plant-cell cityPlant cells have everything: a cell wall, chloroplasts and one big central vacuole. (In plant cells the vacuole also does much of the recycling work.)
clips.text: 🌿 Plant-cell cityPlant cells have everything: a cell wall, chloroplasts and one big central vacuole. (In plant cells the vacuole also does much of the recycling work.)

clips.send: RibosomesBuilds proteins by following the instructions from the nucleus.
clips.text: RibosomesBuilds proteins by following the instructions from the nucleus.

clips.send: NucleolusInside the nucleus: makes the parts of ribosomes.
clips.text: NucleolusInside the nucleus: makes the parts of ribosomes.

clips.send: The vacuole is the water tower and warehouse, storing water and supplies. Lysosomes are the recycling crew: they break down worn-out parts and waste so the pieces can be reused.
clips.text: The vacuole is the water tower and warehouse, storing water and supplies. Lysosomes are the recycling crew: they break down worn-out parts and waste so the pieces can be reused.

clips.send: It is stiff and holds its shape, but has gaps that let water and small molecules through. A fence doesn’t hold anything up; a cell wall also supports the plant like a skeleton. (The “carefully decides” job belongs to the membrane: that is the skin-like one!)

clips.send: Cell membraneControls what enters and leaves the cell; protects it.
clips.text: Cell membraneControls what enters and leaves the cell; protects it.

clips.send: 高尔基体’ěrjītǐ对蛋白质进行加工、分类和包装，装进囊泡运到需要的地方。
clips.text: 高尔基体Gāo’ěrjītǐ对蛋白质进行加工、分类和包装，装进囊泡运到需要的地方。

clips.send: 解释为什么说线粒体像发电厂。
clips.text: 解释为什么说线粒体像发电厂。

clips.send: 细胞膜控制物质进出细胞，保护细胞。
clips.text: 细胞膜控制物质进出细胞，保护细胞。

clips.send: 每个细胞器都有自己的工作，就像城市里的每座建筑一样。好的类比要比工作，而不是比长相。现在去建造你自己的细胞城市吧！
clips.text: 每个细胞器都有自己的工作，就像城市里的每座建筑一样。好的类比要比工作，而不是比长相。现在去建造你自己的细胞城市吧！

clips.send: 核糖体按照细胞核发出的指令合成蛋白质。
clips.text: 核糖体按照细胞核发出的指令合成蛋白质。

clips.send: 中央大液泡一个装满细胞液的大液泡：储存水分，让植物细胞保持硬挺。
clips.text: 中央大液泡yèpào一个装满细胞液的大液泡：储存水分，让植物细胞保持硬挺。

clips.send: 下一站是邮局：高尔基体。它对蛋白质进行最后加工，装进泡泡一样的囊泡，再运到需要的地方，甚至运出细胞。
clips.text: 下一站是邮局：高尔基体。它对蛋白质进行最后加工，装进泡泡一样的囊泡，再运到需要的地方，甚至运出细胞。

clips.send: 线粒体动力车间：通过呼吸作用，把有机物（糖）中的能量释放出来。
clips.text: 线粒体动力车间：通过呼吸作用，把有机物（糖）中的能量释放出来。

clips.send: 植物还是动物？点出这个植物细胞里动物细胞“没有”的 3 个结构。
clips.text: 🔍 植物还是动物？点出这个植物细胞里动物细胞“没有”的 3 个结构。

clips.send: 发电厂：线粒体。它们利用氧气把糖里储存的能量释放出来，制造 ATP，其他所有“建筑”都靠它运转。
clips.text: 发电厂：线粒体。它们利用氧气把糖里储存的能量释放出来，制造 ATP，其他所有“建筑”都靠它运转。

clips.send: 放大一片叶子。每一个绿色的小格子都是一个细胞，每个细胞都像一座有成千上万项工作的繁忙城市。

clips.send: 细胞质充满细胞的胶状液体，容纳各种细胞器，许多化学反应在这里进行。

clips.send: 它不断地把“燃料”（糖和氧气）变成全细胞都能用的能量。 线粒体制造的 ATP 才是真正的“电池”！而且一个细胞可以有几千个线粒体，不止一座发电厂。

clips.send: 细胞壁植物细胞外面坚硬的一层：支持和保护细胞，维持细胞的形状。
clips.text: 细胞壁植物细胞外面坚硬的一层：支持和保护细胞，维持细胞的形状。

clips.send: 每座城市都需要边境。细胞膜就是检查站：它让一些物质进来，把另一些挡在外面。植物细胞在它外面还有一层坚硬的细胞壁，就像石头城墙。
clips.text: 每座城市都需要边境。细胞膜就是检查站：它让一些物质进来，把另一些挡在外面。植物细胞在它外面还有一层坚硬的细胞壁，就像石头城墙。

clips.send: 动物细胞城市有两座建筑消失了：石头城墙（没有细胞壁）和太阳能食品农场（没有叶绿体）。动物靠吃食物获取营养，而不是自己制造。水塔也变小了：动物细胞只有很小的液泡。
clips.text: 🐾 动物细胞城市有两座建筑消失了：石头城墙（没有细胞壁）和太阳能食品农场（没有叶绿体yèlǜtǐ）。动物靠吃食物获取营养，而不是自己制造。水塔也变小了：动物细胞只有很小的液泡yèpào。

clips.send: 它坚硬、能保持形状，但有空隙，水和小分子可以通过。 围栏不能撑起任何东西，而细胞壁还像骨架一样支撑着植物。（“仔细挑选”是细胞膜的工作，像皮肤的是它！）

clips.send: 为什么植物细胞有细胞壁、叶绿体和中央大液泡，而动物细胞没有？
clips.text: 为什么植物细胞有细胞壁、叶绿体和中央大液泡，而动物细胞没有？

clips.send: 液泡是水塔和仓库，储存水和各种物资。溶酶体是回收队：它们把衰老的结构和废物分解，让材料可以再利用。
clips.text: 液泡是水塔和仓库，储存水和各种物资。溶酶体是回收队：它们把衰老的结构和废物分解，让材料可以再利用。
